rows.name: Buy & hold
rows.why: Buy once, never sell. The benchmark every rule has to beat. Tax is only paid when you finally sell.
rows.settings: buy once

rows.name: Trend filter
rows.why: Hold only while the price is above its N-day average; sit in cash when it's below. Aims to dodge long crashes.
rows.settings: re-chosen each year from the previous 2 years

rows.name: Average crossover
rows.why: Hold while a fast average is above a slow one (the classic 'golden cross'). Slower to react, fewer trades.
rows.settings: re-chosen each year from the previous 2 years

rows.name: Breakout
rows.why: Buy when the price makes a new N-day high, sell on a new M-day low. Rides big moves, ignores noise.
rows.settings: re-chosen each year from the previous 2 years

rows.name: Fear & Greed (market mood)
rows.why: Uses the daily Crypto Fear & Greed index, built from volatility, momentum, social media and search trends. Buy when the crowd is fearful, sell when it's greedy.
rows.settings: re-chosen each year from the previous 2 years

rows.name: Rotation (strongest of 5 coins)
rows.why: Every week, move the whole wallet into whichever coin rose most over the last L days; hold cash if all of them fell.
rows.settings: re-chosen each year from the previous 2 years

rows.name: Your current bot
rows.why: The live bot's rules: EMA 9/21 crossover with RSI filter, 2% stop-loss, 4% take-profit, on 15-minute candles.
rows.settings: 15-min candles
